description: Authoritative repository-local HIVE skill catalogue. Every entry maps to native HIVE code; no descriptor, prompt body or runtime dependency is loaded from a shared bucket or third-party skill source.

items.title: CI and runtime log analysis
items.description: Analyses CI, runtime and deployment output to identify the first meaningful failure and the smallest safe next step.
items.when_to_use: Use for GitHub Actions, Koyeb, Cloudflare Pages or application runtime diagnostic evidence.

items.title: Repository diagnosis
items.description: Inspects repository evidence, failing tests and build artefacts to produce a bounded diagnosis and reviewable change plan.
items.when_to_use: Use when an uploaded repository, stack trace or failing build needs evidence-grounded triage.

items.title: Audit report review
items.description: Summarises audit bundles, highlights production risks and turns evidence into a review-gated improvement path.
items.when_to_use: Use for RAMS, AIMS or HIVE audit reports, readiness checks and QA evidence packs.

items.title: Local skill catalogue integrity
items.description: Validates HIVE's bundled skill records for required fields, duplicate identifiers, safe implementation paths and taxonomy drift.
items.when_to_use: Use after changing the local catalogue or before a HIVE release.

items.title: Repository hygiene
items.description: Finds duplicate, generated or stale files and returns a reviewable deletion manifest without deleting automatically.
items.when_to_use: Use before repository cleanup work or when generated artefacts and superseded notes obscure the production tree.

items.title: Production readiness
items.description: Validates production-critical configuration, dependency gates and operator safety before deployment.
items.when_to_use: Use before deployment or after authentication, database, storage or model-routing changes.

items.title: Storage lane review
items.description: Reviews configured storage lanes, bucket mappings and access modes for safe bounded read and write behaviour.
items.when_to_use: Use when adding a storage lane, checking file access or diagnosing object-store behaviour.

items.title: Model routing review
items.description: Checks model defaults, fallback policy and routing evidence against cost, quality and reliability goals.
items.when_to_use: Use when replies are slow, truncated, empty or routed through unsuitable models.
